items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: another movie that I did at Paramount Studios with Louis Armstrong and Mae West.

ctx.x: You also said that you would talk about working for Vincente Minnelli, because you ...

Well, Vincente Minnelli -- I was trying to recall, but I'm sure it was Busby Berkeley that did "Strike Up the Band" -- but Vincente Minnelli, what I did with him was some of the things that I did with Lena Horne. There was one thing that we did out there, I don't know what it was -- I can't remember what it was, but it was -- one of the featured things in it was about Jericho -- "Blowing Down the Walls of Jericho" or something; there was a trumpet player. I got him to do the thing. His name was Jack [Traner,] who…

That was a movie that Lena was in, and there was a big scene in there, you know. The big thing in town at the time with all the studios running were extras, you know. Whites and blacks got a lot of work from being extras. So they used to always have to go out to the casting thing.
